A little about me

The strategist behind the calendar

A few years ago I sat down with a coach who was genuinely brilliant at what she did. Her clients loved her, her results were real, but her Instagram looked abandoned. Not because she was lazy. She just didn't know what to post, so she posted nothing.

I built her a calendar. Not a vague plan to "post more," an actual system: pillars to write from, a rotation to follow, a reason for every post to exist. Within weeks her page looked like a business again. That's when I understood what I was actually good at, not writing captions, building what's underneath them.

"Consistency isn't a personality trait. It's a system. I build the system."

Almost nobody struggling online lacks expertise. You know your field, you have the results and the stories, what's missing is the infrastructure that turns that into content people can find, trust, and book from. That's what I build: the pillars, the calendar, the automations, so growth stops depending on inspiration showing up.

Questions, answered

The things people usually ask before we hop on a call.

I have three plans. They start at $400 a month. Each plan has clear things you get. You can see it all on my pricing page. No hidden costs.

It's a monthly plan. I keep working for you every month. This helps your content grow step by step, not just once.

Good content takes a little time to work. Most people start seeing real change in 4 to 6 weeks. Some things, like more replies and comments, happen even faster.

No one can honestly promise exact numbers. Social media doesn't work like that. What I can promise is a real plan, real effort, and content built to bring the right people to you.

We talk. I want you happy. If something is not working, we fix it together. You are never stuck with content you don't like.

No. You don't need anything ready. That's actually my job. I help you build it from the start.

Yes. That's the whole point. I don't do generic posts. I learn how you talk, then I write like you, not like everyone else.

Yes. I send you every post at least one week before it goes live. You look at it and give the okay. Nothing goes out without your approval.

Not much. A short call sometimes, and quick replies when I need info from you. I do the heavy work.
